faqs.a: Yes. B’s Wax Auto Spa offers mobile interior detailing in Southwest Houston and surrounding areas. Share your ZIP code when requesting a detail so we can confirm coverage.

faqs.q: How much will my detail cost?
faqs.a: Request a quote with your vehicle type and main concerns. The team will confirm the service, price and time before your appointment is booked.

faqs.q: Is my appointment confirmed when I submit?
faqs.a: Your submission is a request. The team will contact you to confirm availability and the final details.
Results depend on the material, condition and age of the stain. The team can assess what is achievable before starting.
